fluff.overview: Under the reforms of Precentor Martial Anastasius Focht, Com Guard infantry train extensively in combined-arms cooperation, conducting regular exercises alongside heavier elements to ensure seamless coordination across all branches when battle demands it. Jump infantry Level I formations provide the vertical mobility needed to operate in urban environments and mountainous terrain. Com Guard jump troops train to exploit three-dimensional movement as a tactical advantage, clearing rooftops and elevated positions that conventional foot infantry cannot reach without significant delay. Carrying infantry-portable long-range missile systems that extend the platoon's engagement envelope well beyond personal weapon range, these troops provide indirect fire support that can suppress enemy positions from distances where return fire is difficult.
